title: Structural safety.
officialText:
The building or structure shall not be weakened by the installation of mechanical systems. Where floors,
walls, ceilings or any other portion of the building or structure are required to be altered or replaced in the process of installing or
repairing any system, the building or structure shall be left in a safe structural condition in accordance with the New York City
Building Code.
